name: flagtrack
description: FlagTrack — análise e evolução de atletas de Flag Football

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
